message:
Add a daily login reward, achievements, a global leaderboard and analytics

- Daily reward: 3 Enchanted Coins the first time you play each day (UTC),
  with a streak; players online past midnight get the next one too.
- Achievements: 17 lifetime goals (kills, wins, top-3, matches, forging,
  chests, coffers, crafting, familiars, a Shiny, an auction sale, a 7-day
  streak), each paying coins once. Existing stats count. Optional Roblox
  badges via Config.Achievements.BadgeIds. A new Achievements window
  (Dock button in the Plaza / library) shows progress bars, rewards and
  the daily streak.
- Hall of Champions: a board behind the Plaza spawn with the global top 10
  by wins and by kills (OrderedDataStores, refreshed every 2 minutes).
- Analytics through Roblox's AnalyticsService: an onboarding funnel, every
  coin source and sink (dev panel excluded), and custom events for match
  results, kit picks and purchases, achievements and streaks.
- Services announce what happens on a small Events bus; the new services
  listen to it, so game code doesn't depend on them.
- Profiles save counters, unlocked achievements, the daily streak and
  logged onboarding steps.
- Tests: the client sim covers the streak, unlocks, coins, badges, the
  window, the leaderboard round trip and the analytics calls (with mock
  ordered DataStores, BadgeService and AnalyticsService); the match sim
  checks the board fills in. docs/CATALOG.md lists the achievements.

Fix the stray "Label" on the HUD and every icon that drew as a square

- The cast-delay bar's text overlay was never filled in, so Roblox showed
  its default "Label". UI text objects made through Create now start
  empty. The sim's mock now uses Roblox's real "Label"/"Button" defaults
  so this shows up in tests and snapshots.
- Replaced symbols Roblox's fonts don't have: robe sigils (☾ ❦ ◉ ♆ ∞ ♛ ✺
  ✦ become 🌙 🍃 👁️ 🔱 ♾️ 👑 💫 ⭐), the window close buttons (✕ becomes a
  heavy X), ✦/★ bullets, arrows and ⟳.
- Added U+FE0F to emoji that only draw as emoji with it (⚔ ⚖ ⚙ ❤ ⏱ ♻ ▶ ◀
  ↩ 👁 🛠 🗳 ☀ ❄ ☯ ⚠).
- Swapped emoji too new for Roblox's emoji font: coins 🪙 → 💰, Sawblade
  🪚 → ⚙️, Returning 🪃 → ↪️, Void Jelly 🪼 → 🦑, black cat → 🐈, Gel Slime
  🟢 → 💚, Blood 🩸 → 🥀 / Bloodmage 🧛.
- tools/sim/glyphs.luau (with generated emoji_data.luau) scans the source
  for anything Roblox would draw as a square; it runs in CI.

Polish every arena, widen the spawn, rebalance damage and loot, nicer robes

Maps
- Each arena now has its own terrain features: winding rivers in broad
  valleys (water, frozen glacier, lava, or a dry wadi), stepped mesas
  with striped canyon cliffs, and a smoking volcano on Ashen Wastes.
- The rim is a ring of uneven peaks instead of one flat wall.
- Roads run from the plaza to every landmark, with wooden bridges over
  rivers (or raised causeways over lava).
- Richer terrain colour: per-map material patches, wet banks, oasis
  grass, striped cliffs.
- New decoration library (Decor.lua): autumn trees, flower meadows, tall
  grass, reeds, logs, mushroom rings, snowmen, frost bushes, glowing
  crystals, basalt columns, ember vents, hoodoos, urns, bones, glow
  flowers, fireflies.
- Landmarks.lua: the classic four restyled (arch, ivy, banners, roofs,
  lanterns), plus two signature landmarks per map: Ancient Oak and
  Windmill, Ice Spire and Lodge, Forge and Obsidian Gate, Step Pyramid
  and Bazaar, Fairy Ring and Giant Stump.
- Scenery.lua: bridges, the volcano's plume and an aurora over Frostpeak.
- Per-map colour grading, bloom, sun rays and clouds. Future lighting
  and terrain grass are enabled in the place.
- Bots pick dry ground to wander to.

Spawn
- Cornucopia plaza radius 34 -> 50, pedestals 46 -> 72 (about 38 studs
  apart). Patterned floor in the map's colours, banners and themed flair.
  Chests: 6 on the dais, 4 out on the plaza.

Balance
- Config.Combat.SpellDamageMultiplier = 0.6 (applied in SpellBuilder, so
  tooltips match).
- Chests roll 1-4 items instead of 3-6, plus a 50-80% chance of a
  Healing Draught.

Cosmetics
- Robes get sleeves with flared, trimmed cuffs, V lapels, a standing
  collar, a smoothly flaring pleated skirt with a front panel, a belt
  buckle and a round gold-rimmed sigil medallion. Capes are lined;
  Royal, Shadow and Celestial get mantles or cowls.
- Pointed and witch hats are smooth cones with a curling tip.

Tools
- tools/sim/mapshot.luau + tools/ui/maprender.cjs render arenas, the hub
  and an outfit line-up as PNGs for review.

Restyle every screen and add proximity chat

UI
- One window frame for every menu: dimmed backdrop, gold-trimmed panel,
  title, close button (Widgets.window), plus shared tabs, item cards,
  item rows, section headers and chips.
- Spellbook: wand cards with stat chips and perks, a bag split into
  Spells / Parts / Potions tabs with named cards grouped by type, and a
  Spellforge with a clear live preview and a Forge button.
- Chest, kit shop, wardrobe, Tailor's Loom, auction house and dev panel
  all use the new frame; robe/hat parts and familiars show short names.
- Menu buttons live in one column on the left (UI/Dock) and hide while
  a window is open; refreshed HUD panels and colour palette.

Proximity chat
- Server-side ChatService filters RBXGeneral so text only reaches
  players within Config.Chat.Range (70) studs; bubbles fade at the same
  range. Config.Chat.Proximity = false restores server-wide chat.
- TextChatService is set as the chat version in the project file, and
  the client posts a short note explaining the range.

Tools
- tools/sim/uishot.luau + tools/ui/render.cjs save every screen the
  client sim opens and draw them as PNGs for layout review.
- Client sim covers proximity chat (near, far, between lives, off).

Add the Dev panel: unlock everything and test the whole game for free

- One-click Unlock Everything: every kit, 100,000 coins, free coffers, every robe/hat design and
  aura, an outfit of every rarity (a Mythic set worn), every familiar plus a Shiny Mythic of
  each, and a full spell loadout at the start of every match
- Coins, cosmetics and familiars by rarity, kit modes (all / normal / locked to test the shop),
  god mode, infinite mana, any wand or premade spell, match controls (start now, skip the vote,
  countdown or grace, jump the clock, end the match, bot count, refill chests), Test Merchant
  listings and a profile reset
- Opens with the backquote key or the Dev button; available in Studio and to the experience's
  owner (plus Config.Dev.AdminUserIds) in live servers, checked server-side on every request
- Studio play tests save to separate stores; dev-panel items can't be sold on the auction house
- Sims cover Unlock Everything, the switches, strangers being refused, profile reset, and
  starting / skipping / ending a match from the panel

Familiars: 21 collectible companions from coffers, with minor powers from Rare up

- Any coffer item can be a familiar (3% to 15% per item by coffer, same rarity odds); 1 in 40
  is Shiny. 21 species from Common to Mythic (Mythic ones only in the Celestial Reliquary),
  2-4 colours each: 532 distinct familiars
- Common and Uncommon familiars are purely visual. From Rare up each species has one small
  power that grows with rarity: speed, jump, mana regen, coins, damage reduction, regen,
  element damage, Keen Nose (outlines nearby chests), Night Eyes (briefly outlines the nearest
  enemy), Nip (2-5 damage every 8s) or Last Ember (a burst when its mage falls)
- Familiars are built from parts and animated client-side (wings, tails, tentacles, orbiting
  shards); rarer ones glow, sparkle, carry elemental auras and leave trails
- Familiars tab in the wardrobe, coffer reveals and disclosed odds, auction house support,
  saved with the profile; about a third of bots bring one along
- Unit tests for rolls and powers; client sim covers every species at every rarity, summoning,
  each kind of power, coffer drops, trading and saving

Kit tiers from $0.99 to $25 with random bonus parts; 20 new spell parts

Kits
- 17 kits across 7 tiers: a free Novice kit plus Copper ($0.99, 80 R$),
  Silver ($2.99), Gold ($4.99), Arcane ($9.99), Astral ($14.99) and
  Archmage ($24.99). Kit strength scales with price: Common flavour
  wands at Copper, Legendary twin-cast staffs with legendary spells at
  Archmage. New kits: Artificer, Chronomancer, Swarmlord, Stormlord,
  Void Archon, Archmage and Harbinger.
- Each kit gives one random spell part per match, rolled with its
  tier's odds (from 100% Common up to 45% Legendary). The odds are shown
  in the kit shop and in the Grimoire before purchase.
- Each paid kit is its own game pass (Config.Kits.GamePassIds).
  Ownership is checked on join and updated on purchase. Roblox Premium
  members get the Copper tier free, and Studio unlocks everything. Bots
  only use kits up to Gold.
- The class picker is now a scrolling kit shop grouped by tier, with
  prices, owned/selected state and buy buttons.

Spells
- Forms: Sawblade, Swarm, Rampart (conjured walls that block movement
  and spells), Tornado, Black Hole and Sentry (a hovering turret whose
  shots inherit its modifiers and whose payloads aim at enemies).
- Elements: Chaos (random damage and status per hit) and Chrono (hits
  rewind the target 2s).
- Modifiers: Stasis, Returning, Magnetic, Gigantic, Skyfall, Transpose,
  Barrage, Hydra (splits on every bounce) and Fractal (self-splitting,
  stackable).
- Triggers: Proximity, On Bounce and On Kill.
- 20 new premade spells built from them, including Doom Turret, Event
  Horizon and Kaleidoscope.
- Swaps, pulls, rewinds and wall shoves use a shared
  DamageService.canHurt rule, so none of them work in the grace period
  or from the Spell Lab.

Tests: the combat sim checks every new mechanic (and the mock engine
now raycasts against conjured walls). The client sim buys a kit through
the shop. New unit tests cover tier prices, odds and the new parts.

Add the Arcanum Plaza hub and a join queue; grace period 5s

- Grace period is 5 seconds (was 20), so rushing the cornucopia is a
  real risk again.
- New hub, Arcanum Plaza: every player spawns here and can hang out and
  practise for as long as they like. It has a mana fountain, benches,
  stalls and towers, a Practice Range with standing and moving training
  dummies, a gazebo with the Class Altar and Grimoire lecterns, and a
  live Next Match board.
- Queue: walking through the hub portal (or pressing Join Game) queues
  you and moves you to the library, where the map vote happens. Only
  queued players are put in matches, and nothing starts until someone
  queues. Players stay queued between matches. The library's portal (or
  Leave queue) returns you to the Plaza and withdraws your vote. A full
  queue cuts the vote to 10s, and more than 24 queued players are served
  first come, first served.
- Only queued players can vote. Match banners go to the library and the
  fighters; hub players get a toast instead.
- The hub and the library share building blocks in Map/Props.lua.
- Tests: the match sim covers the hub spawn, joining via the portal,
  leaving via the library portal and the Join/Leave remote. The client
  sim covers the Join/Leave buttons, vote gating and queue order. The
  maps sim checks the hub, the portals and the moving dummies.

- Grimoire (H): an in-game encyclopedia covering crafting, wands, every

- Spellbook hotkey moved from Tab (Roblox player list) to B.
- Maps: 5 data-driven maps (Verdant Isle, Frostpeak, Ashen Wastes,

- Fewer chests: 10 in the cornucopia and 24-30 scattered at least 55

- Map vote: 3 random maps (never the one just played) before every
  match, with a random tie-break.
- Tests: new maps sim. The client sim now covers hotkeys, the vote, the

Add Mana Wars: survival-games battle royale with Noita-style spellcrafting

A complete Roblox game (Rojo project, Luau):

- Spell system: 54 parts (15 forms, 10 elements, 25 modifiers, 4 triggers)
  combined in a Spellforge into ~67M single-layer spells; triggers carry
  nested payload spells up to 3 deep. 49 premade spells, all dismantlable.
- Noita-style wands: procedural rarity, slots, mana, cast delay, recharge,
  multicast, shuffle and perks (affinity, always-cast, siphon, lifesteal).
- Survival-games match loop: sky lobby, procedurally generated island,
  cornucopia + scattered chests, pedestal countdown, grace period,
  mid-game chest refill, shrinking mana storm, death satchels, winner.
- Server-authoritative casting, projectiles, damage, status effects,
  zones; bots fill empty slots; premium classes via Roblox Premium or a
  game pass; DataStore stats.
- Client HUD, Spellbook/Spellforge, chest looting, class picker,
  spectating, spell visual effects and storm.
- Tests: Luau unit tests, plus Lune simulations that run the real server
  combat code, a client+server UI integration test, and full matches.
- Prebuilt place file in build/ManaWars.rbxlx, CI workflow, generated
  catalogue in docs/CATALOG.md.
